mapper.sql: f.forecast_id, f.city_code, c.city_name, f.forecast_time, f.forecast_date, f.weather_text, f.temp_min, f.temp_max, f.humidity, f.wind_level, f.data_source, f.collect_time, f.version, f.revoked, f.revoked_at, f.revoked_by, f.revoke_reason, f.created_at, f.updated_at
mapper.select: select from weather_forecast f left join weather_city c on c.city_code = f.city_code
select from weather_forecast f left join weather_city c on c.city_code = f.city_code where f.forecast_id = #{forecastId}
select from weather_forecast f left join weather_city c on c.city_code = f.city_code where f.city_code = #{cityCode} and f.revoked = 0 order by f.forecast_time desc limit 1
select city_code, city_name, latitude, longitude, enabled, data_source, remark, created_at, updated_at from weather_city order by enabled desc, city_code
select city_code, city_name, latitude, longitude, enabled, data_source, remark, created_at, updated_at from weather_city where city_code = #{cityCode}
mapper.insert: insert into weather_city (city_code, city_name, latitude, longitude, enabled, data_source, remark, create_by) values (#{cityCode}, #{cityName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, coalesce(#{enabled}, 1), #{dataSource}, coalesce(#{remark}, ''), #{createBy})
mapper.update: update weather_city set city_name = #{cityName}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, enabled = #{enabled}, data_source = #{dataSource}, remark = coalesce(#{remark}, '') where city_code = #{cityCode}
mapper.insert: insert into weather_forecast (city_code, forecast_time, forecast_date, weather_text, temp_min, temp_max, humidity, wind_level, data_source, collect_time, version, revoked) values (#{cityCode}, #{forecastTime}, #{forecastDate}, #{weatherText}, #{tempMin}, #{tempMax}, #{humidity}, #{windLevel}, #{dataSource}, coalesce(#{collectTime}, now()), 0, 0)
mapper.update: update weather_forecast set weather_text = #{weatherText}, temp_min = #{tempMin}, temp_max = #{tempMax}, humidity = #{humidity}, wind_level = #{windLevel}, data_source = #{dataSource}, version = version + 1 where forecast_id = #{forecastId} and version = #{version} and revoked = 0
update weather_forecast set revoked = 1, revoked_at = now(), revoked_by = #{operator}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 where forecast_id = #{forecastId} and revoked = 0
mapper.insert: insert into weather_forecast (city_code, forecast_time, forecast_date, weather_text, temp_min, temp_max, humidity, wind_level, data_source, collect_time, version, revoked) values (#{cityCode}, #{forecastTime}, #{forecastDate}, #{weatherText}, #{tempMin}, #{tempMax}, #{humidity}, #{windLevel}, #{dataSource}, coalesce(#{collectTime}, now()), 0, 0) on duplicate key update weather_text = values(weather_text), temp_min = values(temp_min), temp_max = values(temp_max), humidity = values(humidity), wind_level = values(wind_level), data_source = values(data_source), collect_time = values(collect_time), revoked = 0, revoked_at = null, revoked_by = null, revoke_reason = null, version = version + 1

insert into weather_collect_log (city_code, collect_status, forecast_count, accepted_count, last_success_at, error_code, message, request_id) values (#{cityCode}, #{collectStatus}, coalesce(#{forecastCount}, 0), coalesce(#{acceptedCount}, 0), #{lastSuccessAt}, #{errorCode}, #{message}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: select collect_id, city_code, collect_status, forecast_count, accepted_count, last_success_at, error_code, message, request_id, collect_time from weather_collect_log where city_code = #{cityCode} order by collect_time desc, collect_id desc limit 1

select count(1) as total, count(distinct f.city_code) as cityCount, coalesce(sum(case when f.revoked = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as revoked, coalesce(sum(case when f.forecast_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as upcoming from weather_forecast f
